status: experimental name auditions; no name chosen
note: TTS was given the seven exact candidate spellings, including TheDie vs The Die.

candidates.tts_text_one: The old roads have brought you to Brother Rubicon. This is the die's cast. Listen well.
candidates.tts_text_two: Beyond this threshold, there is no going back. Brother Rubicon will see you across.

candidates.tts_text_one: The old roads have brought you to Brother TheDie. This is the die's cast. Listen well.
candidates.tts_text_two: A name may be a sign, or merely a sound. Mine is Brother TheDie. Now, shall we begin?

candidates.tts_text_one: The old roads have brought you to Brother The Die. This is the die's cast. Listen well.
candidates.tts_text_two: Some folk swear that fortune has a face. They call me Brother The Die. I have never seen it.

candidates.tts_text_one: The old roads have brought you to Brother Thudiey. This is the die's cast. Listen well.
candidates.tts_text_two: The last bell has rung, and no one knows why. Brother Thudiey knows even less.

candidates.tts_text_one: The old roads have brought you to Brother Thudie. This is the die's cast. Listen well.
candidates.tts_text_two: The fire is warm, and the hour is late. Brother Thudie, they call me. Sit, and hear what chance has to say.

candidates.tts_text_one: The old roads have brought you to Brother The Dhai. This is the die's cast. Listen well.
candidates.tts_text_two: A traveler once asked my name. I told him: Brother The Dhai. He wrote it wrong, of course.

candidates.tts_text_one: The old roads have brought you to Brother Thadhai. This is the die's cast. Listen well.
candidates.tts_text_two: What is a name but an old word spoken twice? Brother Thadhai is quite enough for me.

candidates.tts_text_one: The old roads have brought you to Brother Berengar. This is the die's cast. Listen well.
candidates.tts_text_two: I am Brother Berengar. The road is long, and chance has not yet spoken.
